args.sql:
CREATE VIEW effective_leverage AS
SELECT 
    r.levscale AS position_leverage,
    r.possum AS position_value,
    a.walletsum AS balance,
    (r.posmagn * (r.possum / a.walletsum)) AS effective_leverage
FROM 
    riskandmargin r
JOIN 
    accountbalances a ON r.riskandmarginpivot = a.accountbalancesnode;
